Then each refused attempt is written to the ACE audit log and the entry is unchanged

  Scenario: AC13 A call to a provided operation without valid authentication is answered 401 and returns nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller without valid authentication
    When the caller calls GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log with caseId "RW-2026-000777"
    Then the answer is 401 and nothing is returned
    When the caller calls GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log/{entryId} with entryId "DLE-SYN-3012"
    Then the answer is 401 and nothing is returned

  Scenario: AC14 A consumed call that fails or does not answer writes nothing and raises an incident (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case reference-data contract mock does not answer for LOV-DECISION
    When the fact of the key "CASE_EVENT:EV-CASE-0777-01" is consumed
    Then no entry, no chain_seq and no inbox row is written, the fact is redelivered by the broker and an incident is raised
    Then the entry of the key is written only when the call answers and the fact is collected again
